{{Quote|Not going to be easy getting to those guns, sir.''"<br />"''There is ''always'' a way, Wooley.|Wooley and Commander Cody|audio=AlwaysAWay-IoR.flac|<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />}}
'''Wooley''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion's]] [[Ghost Company/Legends|Ghost Company]], under [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. When the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] launched an invasion of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], Kenobi and the 212th were sent to [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|liberate]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. After landing, Wooley and [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Company/Legends|unit]] were tasked with eliminating the Confederate [[J-1 semi-autonomous proton cannon|proton cannons]] defending the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Nabat/Legends|Nabat]] so that the Republic [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|transports]] could land. After destroying the city's outer Confederate defenses, Wooley accompanied [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], and fellow [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] [[Waxer/Legends|Waxer]] and [[Boil/Legends|Boil]], to [[Scout/Legends|scout]] ahead.

Cody and Wooley went to investigate Nabat's central courtyard and discovered that the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] of the city were being held by the Confederate [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] to serve as "living shields" surrounding the [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]]. After reporting their findings back to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] Kenobi and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], Wooley and his company moved out. Meanwhile, Waxer and Boil&mdash;with the help of the young Twi'lek [[Numa/Legends|Numa]], who they had encountered on their own patrol&mdash;had found a way to free the [[Prisoner/Legends|captives]]; while Wooley and and his fellow [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] created a diversion, Kenobi, Waxer, and Boil freed the Twi'lek prisoners and destroyed the proton [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]]. The main body of Republic [[Troop/Legends|troops]] was able to land on Ryloth and eventually liberate the planet.

==Biography==
The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who would take on the name Wooley<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] as a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]]<ref name="SWE" /> of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="clone troopers">{{DB|organization|clonetroopers|clone troopers}}</ref> Wooley served in [[Ghost Company/Legends|Ghost Company]], a [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]] [[Company/Legends|detachment]] under the command of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], and [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. After [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] invaded the planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Star Wars Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] mounted an offensive to [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|liberate]] the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]]-occupied world. [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], were able to destroy the Separatist [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] surrounding the planet, allowing the ground invasion forces of Kenobi and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] to move in and approach Ryloth.<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth">{{TCW|Storm Over Ryloth}}</ref>

[[File:Cody_and_Wooley.png|thumb|left|250px|Commander Cody and Wooley discover that the Twi'leks are being held hostage.]]
Kenobi, Cody, Wooley and the rest of Ghost Company boarded the [[Crumb Bomber/Legends|''Crumb Bomber'']] and other [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]] and attempted to land in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Nabat/Legends|Nabat]]. However, Confederate [[J-1 semi-autonomous proton cannon]]s attacked the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|Republic transports]] above, and Windu tasked Kenobi with taking out the [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]] to allow the main body of ground [[Troop/Legends|troops]] to land. After landing, Kenobi and Ghost Company managed to destroy the outer defenses of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] positions and moved into Nabat.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

Shortly after Ghost Company established a base, Kenobi ordered Wooley, along with Cody and [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] [[Waxer/Legends|Waxer]] and [[Boil/Legends|Boil]], to [[Scout/Legends|scout]] ahead. Splitting up from Waxer and Boil, Wooley and Cody went to investigate the city's courtyard and discovered that Nabat's [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] inhabitants were being held [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] by the droid forces as "living shields" to protect the Confederate proton cannons. Wooley believed that freeing the prisoners would not be easy, though General Kenobi responded that there was always a way. The two [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] returned to their base and reported their findings to Kenobi and Windu&mdash;the latter of whom was unable to land and was present as a [[holograph]]&mdash;and Ghost Company moved out to the village. However, Wooley and his company were attacked by [[Gutkurr/Legends|gutkurr]] creatures, which had been starved and then released by the [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|tactical droid]] [[TX-20/Legends|TX-20]], the leader of the Confederate forces stationed in Nabat.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

Kenobi managed to [[Animal bond|lure]] the gutkurrs into an alley with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and Wooley and his group destroyed a [[bridge]] above the entrance, collapsing the structure and trapping the creatures. Waxer and Boil then emerged from an underground tunnel with the young Twi'lek [[Numa/Legends|Numa]], who they had encountered on their own reconnaissance of the city, and Kenobi learned from the Twi'lek that she could lead them to the prisoners. Wooley and the rest of Ghost Company created a diversion by attacking the droids, while Kenobi, Waxer, and Boil freed the prisoners and also managed to take out the proton cannons. With the proton cannons destroyed, Windu and his forces were able to land on the planet<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> and eventually liberate Ryloth.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
When Kenobi ordered Cody to take the best scouts in Ghost Company to reconnoiter ahead, Cody chose Wooley, among others, to accompany him. After Wooley and his commander discovered the Twi'lek captives, Wooley expressed his doubt about the mission's potential success.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> As a clone of Jango Fett,<ref name="clone troopers" /> Wooley was 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="SWE" />

==Equipment==
In combat, Wooley wore [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] and was armed with a [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]].<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Wooley! We need a medic here!|A clone trooper calls to Wooley in an altered version of the Battle of [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]]|<ref name="The Clones Are Coming">The Clones Are Coming webisode featured on the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] Blu-ray release</ref>}}
Wooley was first featured in "[[Innocents of Ryloth]]," an episode of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired on [[March 6]], [[2009]]. Like all clone troopers in the series, Wooley was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="SWArchive-''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Innocents of Ryloth">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode020.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Innocents of Ryloth}}</ref> Wooley was also featured in the young readers book ''[[The Clone Wars: The Battle for Ryloth]]'', though he was not addressed by name by Commander Cody.

Wooley was originally mentioned during the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]] in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''The Clone Wars'' film]]. A clone trooper would have called to Wooley, informing him that another trooper required a medic.<ref name="The Clones Are Coming" /> However, the reference to Wooley was removed by the film's release in [[2008]].<ref name="The Clone Wars">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>
